items.title: Product Manager
bullets:
Led the streaming platform product (ON Live) business with +15 professionals team size (Product, Marketing, Business, KOL). Owned the product vision, roadmap, go-to-market strategy and feature prioritization. 
Built from zero, owned the business model, P&L projections, identifying revenue streams and growth opportunities.
Negotiated a 50% cost reduction with a leading LoL KOLs, built a revenue-sharing policy that signed 10–15 mid-to-high-tier creators.
Opened 10+ dedicated media channels, generating avg. 20–40M in-house social organic views per month.

items.title: Business Development Manager
bullets: Led BD and production; analyzed trends and quantified content IPs to guide investment.
Cut content production cost by 50%, Won 2 strategic production partnerships (USD 270K+ revenue) via end-to-end RFPs.
Built partnerships with publishers and organizers including SOOP, Riot Games, Garena, VNG Games, Huya,...

items.title: Project Lead (Gameplay) & Product Marketing
bullets: Delivered 8+ campaigns tied to gameplay features and measured adoption and user behavior.
Lifted DAU 75%,  revival +2.5% (after a losing streak) in a peak campaign,

500% increase in earned viewership (280M), 50% increase in in-house channels (+55M), 1B VIEWS hashtag - Tiktok UGC.
Built an always-on gameplay content series.

items.title: Marketing Lead, Esports
bullets: Built Esports ecosystem, established SOPs, managed a team of 10 professionals (including local Pakistan agency)  to develop successful tournament projects,  integrated marketing  & communication campaigns (owned & paid media, earned media, publication, in-house & external KOLs, offline events, microsites, digital ads, UGC events).

Executed efficient budget allocations (Marketing/Event Production/Operation…) for better ROIs, adapted to business & market needs to achieve KPIs while still prioritizing user-centric approach. (budget range USD 500K-700K)
Built & Managed microsites with in-house dev team, creative and video production. Used Google Analytics and viewership data to guide each season’s next steps.

bullets: Planned and executed 13+ marketing projects for Tier 1 and Tier 2 esports tournaments.
Built the organic social and community channel ecosystem for the Vietnam market.

2 times in TOP 10 most notable campaigns by BUZZ MATRIC, 1M Like Facebook fanpage, #1 Gaming & #3 General Youtube Trending.
